name: lif-effort
description: Picks the session model and each prompt's effort with one small Haiku call, shows them in a bar above the prompt, and adds Haiku compaction, handoffs, CAFE(S) session reviews, and a subagent panel.

autoModel.title: Automatic session model
autoModel.description: Pick Opus, Sonnet or Haiku 5.5 from the first substantive prompt and keep it for the session. Off: the session's own model is used.

allowedModels.title: Allowed models
allowedModels.description: The models automatic selection may pick.

autoEffort.title: Automatic effort
autoEffort.description: Pick the effort for each prompt. Off: the session's own effort is used.

effortFloor.title: Effort floor
effortFloor.description: Automatic effort never goes below this. Not applied to Haiku.

effortCeiling.title: Effort ceiling
effortCeiling.description: Automatic effort never goes above this. Not applied to Haiku.

effortPreference.title: Effort preference
effortPreference.description: How ambiguous prompts lean: cheaper and faster, deeper reasoning, or neither.

compactionModel.title: Compaction model
compactionModel.description: haiku: Haiku 5.5 writes the summary, with the native compaction as fallback. session: always the native compaction.

afterHandoff.title: After a handoff
afterHandoff.description: continue: clear and carry on. wait: clear and leave the continuation in the prompt box. save: only save HANDOFF.md.

agentVisibility.title: Agent visibility
agentVisibility.description: Which subagents the panel and the bar count.

showReason.title: Show classification reason
showReason.description: Show the classifier's short reason in the bar.

briefFirstPrompt.title: Brief the first prompt
briefFirstPrompt.description: For a session's first substantive prompt, add a short task brief for the model to read beside your words. Costs one more Haiku call, up to 12 seconds.

showStatus.title: Show status line
showStatus.description: Under the bar, show the directory, git branch, context use, and the 5-hour and weekly plan limits.
